preserved_details: When bAllowWindImpulses is false, all cached responders are visited, using global vector; UID snapshot construction still happens, but lifecycle updates do not.

Radius sampling uses CurrentRadius and CurrentMagnitude, spherical distance and linearly decaying radial direction. Cylinder sampling ignores changing entries and zero magnitude, uses XY distance, explicit direction unless exactly zero, inner plateau and linear outer falloff.

Delta sampling uses only first delta, requires successful snapshot lookup and WindImpulseBounds containment, chooses Previous/Current/Desired magnitude by inner/band/outer radius and bRippleOutward, with snapshot cylinder falloff.
Only speed changes trigger material setup and writes. Direction-only changes do not. Wind-vector material write is skipped when speed becomes exactly0. Its alpha is responder bounds midpoint Z.
Curve channels0..3 select WindSpeedCurve RGBA,4..7 WindPannerSpeedCurve RGBA; unknown channels produce0. Paired panner speed/offset equations retain world-time continuity.

Completed first delta is swap-removed; matching cylinder gets final magnitude and changing state based on first remaining matching delta index. Changed event precedes setting pending. Zero idle cylinder removal precedes starting next delta, with final reverse cleanup thereafter.

delta_sampling_assembly.section_selection: 0x141de032a..0x141de035b computes sqrt((Y-centerY)^2 + (X-centerX)^2), then COMISS distance, inner / JAE: unordered falls through to inner. 0x141de065e..0x141de0668 COMISS distance, outer / JBE: unordered takes band. Therefore inner if !(distance >= inner); otherwise band if !(distance > outer); otherwise outer. Equal inner selects band (unless outer smaller); equal outer selects band. Reversed radii have no band for ordered distance >= inner. No section-width division occurs in this selection.
delta_sampling_assembly.live_magnitudes: Delta +0x2c PreviousMagnitude, +0x30 SectionCurrentMagnitude, +0x34 DesiredMagnitude. 0x141de04bc and 0x141de0640 select Desired and Previous respectively for inner outward/inward; 0x141de0a9c selects SectionCurrent for band; 0x141de07cd and 0x141de093e select Previous and Desired respectively for outer outward/inward. These load/multiply live direction registers immediately before accumulation; no uninitialized decompiler scalar needs inference.
delta_sampling_assembly.bounds_comparisons: 0x141de02e1..0x141de0324 tests each coordinate against min using COMISS/JB (unordered rejects) and max using COMISS/JA (unordered passes); bounds validity byte is not consulted. Updated draft preserves this comparison topology.

sampling_numeric_assembly.bounds: Radius 0x141ddfee0..0x141ddff1c and cylinder 0x141de009d..0x141de00d9 each independently test all XYZ: COMISS point,min / JB rejects below OR unordered, COMISS point,max / JA rejects strictly above ordered. Thus point>=min && !(point>max) for each axis. No conditional minimum-coordinate checks exist; previous decompiler topology is rejected. Ignore FBox validity. NaN point/min rejects; NaN max passes if minimum passes.
sampling_numeric_assembly.radius: 0x141ddff22..0x141ddfff3: CurrentRadius must be ordered >0 (JA), otherwise +0 contribution is still added when bounds passed. DX,DY,DZ=P-Location; distance=sqrt((DX*DX+DY*DY)+DZ*DZ). COMISS/JBE chooses zero direction for distance<=1e-8 OR unordered, otherwise reciprocal=1/distance and direction=reciprocal*offset. COMISS distance,radius / JB accepts below OR unordered; otherwise +0 contribution. Accepted magnitude=CurrentMagnitude-(CurrentMagnitude/CurrentRadius)*distance, then magnitude*direction components. NaN distance therefore propagates through NaN magnitude*zero, rather than being silently dropped. NaN/nonpositive radius produces +0. Negative/infinite CurrentMagnitude has no special guard.
sampling_numeric_assembly.cylinder_gate: 0x141de0083..0x141de00ff: changing skips; UCOMISS magnitude,0 / JE skips both signed zero and NaN, retains either sign nonzero/infinity. OuterRadius COMISS/JA requires ordered >0; otherwise all +0 direction components. OuterRadius NaN is not accepted.
sampling_numeric_assembly.direction_zero_test: Regular 0x141de0121..0x141de0156 and all five delta branches use UCOMISS/JNE per explicit direction component. A component is zero-like if zero (either sign) OR unordered; radial XY chosen only when every component is zero-like. Otherwise explicit XYZ retained without normalization. Radial path overwrites X/Y only: original Z, including -0 or NaN, survives. At squared length<=1e-8 OR unordered, X/Y become +0. Otherwise refine rsqrt then multiply by DX,DY.
sampling_numeric_assembly.rsqrt: 0x141de017b..0x141de01db; same sequence all delta branches. R=RSQRTSS(S); H=S*0.5; R=R+R*(0.5-H*(R*R)); R=R+R*(0.5-H*(R*R)). H reused. Preserve intermediate scalar float rounding and do not reassociate to ((H*R)*R). Regular cylinder S=DY*DY+DX*DX; all delta radial S=DX*DX+DY*DY. Draft uses SSE seed and separate float locals; compiler flags must preserve order.
sampling_numeric_assembly.falloff: Regular 0x141de01fc..0x141de0268 and delta branches 0x141de0458..0x141de04b9, 0x141de05d1..0x141de063c, 0x141de0773..0x141de07c9, 0x141de08e3..0x141de093a, 0x141de0a3d..0x141de0a99: distance=sqrt(YY+XX), except outer/inward delta uses sqrt(XX+YY). COMISS distance,outer / JB enters below OR unordered; ordered >=outer gives +0 XYZ. Falloff only for ordered distance>inner (JA or inverse JBE); else retains direction, including unordered distance/inner. Falloff=1-(distance-inner)/(outer-inner), no clamp, multiplied into XYZ. No invented handling for reversed/equal radii: ordered inner>=outer yields plateau at every accepted distance; NaN inner yields plateau. Multiply selected live magnitude only after contribution direction is computed, even if zero; NaN delta magnitude can therefore propagate via zero*NaN.
sampling_numeric_assembly.final_normalization: 0x141de0b35..0x141de0be5: length=sqrt((WX*WX+WY*WY)+WZ*WZ). COMISS/JBE selects +0 XYZ direction when length<=1e-8 OR unordered; else reciprocal=1/length, multiply each wind component. Clamp: if !(length>=0) speed=+0, else if length<1 speed=length, else speed=1. NaN sampled length gives zero direction and speed0, infinity gives speed1 and ordinary division/multiply results. Native multiplies normalized XYZ by clamped speed before material loop; draft does equivalent multiplication at vector write. Abs(speed-oldSpeed) COMISS/JBE skips material writes for <=1e-8 OR unordered.
sampling_numeric_assembly.signed_zero: Zero globals and explicitly zeroed radial XY are +0. Explicit direction Z keeps its original sign even when radial XY chosen; plateau retains explicit signed zeros, falloff and magnitude multiplication may change signs. Bounds-passing radius and accepted cylinder paths still add computed zero contributions, rather than skip them. Final zero direction uses +0; native vector write skipped for speed==0.
